why_this_upstream: raw.githubusercontent.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com are not reachable from the sandbox that built this artefact; codeload.github.com is. The repository archive is therefore the only nflverse source that could be read directly.
limitations: nflverse release assets (player_stats, injuries, depth_charts, pbp, snap_counts) are hosted on release-assets.githubusercontent.com, which this sandbox cannot reach.
www.nfl.com is not reachable from this sandbox, so no league page could be re-fetched while building this artefact.
The archive is a branch snapshot: `master` moves. The SHA-256 above pins the exact bytes, and every artefact records the per-file hashes.
